correctness.rationale: PASS. Multiplying B=(D+L)^{-1}+(D+L^T)^{-1}-D^{-1} by M^T and M with M=D+L gives exactly M^T B M=D-L^TD^{-1}L, hence the sharp SPD criterion ||D^{-1/2}LD^{-1/2}||_2<1. In normalized variables X=(I+C)^{-1}, B~=X^T(I-C^TC)X and B~^{-1}-H=CC^T+(I+C)C^TC(I-C^TC)^{-1}(I+C^T) is positive semidefinite, proving B<=A^{-1}. The filed error identity B~H-I=-XCC^T-X^TC^TC gives the stated O(delta^2) norm bound and condition-number estimate. Independent numerical evaluation of the 3x3 example gives eig(H) approximately (0.2,0.46191685,2.33808315), max eig(C^TC) approximately 1.16166378, and det(B~)=-0.1296, exactly confirming SPD A with indefinite B.

originality.rationale: PASS, qualified by historical-access risk. Standard references and modern surveys describe Jacobi, forward/backward GS, SGS/SSOR, additive/multiplicative splittings, and two-step paradigms, but focused searches did not locate the specific diagonal-corrected sum of the two inverse sweeps, its congruence factorization, or the exact norm-one SPD threshold. Bai (2003) is a plausible historical coverage risk; open-access searches exposed only its abstract, and an authorized Oxford retrieval reached human verification, so its inaccessible full text was not claimed as read.

scientific_value.rationale: PASS. The record gives a sharp safety certificate for a naturally parallelizable additive construction, exhibits that SPD of A is insufficient, and quantifies the useful first-order cancellation by a quadratic clustering bound. The comparison with standard SGS is careful and avoids performance claims.

findings: The congruence factorization proves both necessity and sufficiency of the norm threshold, not merely a sufficient condition.
The inverse-dominance identity implies the entire preconditioned spectrum lies in (0,1] whenever the threshold holds.
The normalized error has no linear term and begins with -(CC^T+C^TC), validating the quadratic weak-coupling interpretation.
The two-block case reduces exactly to diag(I-K^TK,I-KK^T).

limitations: The full text of Bai (2003) was not available through open access and the authorized institutional retrieval required human verification; no claim is made about inaccessible pages.
Originality is therefore qualified to the exact formula/factorization located by indexed search, not an exhaustive negative claim over all historical splitting literature.
The analysis is finite-dimensional, exact-arithmetic, and does not establish implementation speedup or floating-point stability.
